relations.subject: David Shea
relations.evidence: He entered Trinity College, Dublin on 3 June 1793, and in 1797 obtained a scholarship in classics... Shea, refusing to comply, was expelled from the university.

relations.subject: David Shea
relations.role: assistant professorship in the oriental department
relations.evidence: procured him an assistant professorship in the oriental department of the East India Company's Haileybury College... he died at Haileybury College on 11 May 1836.

relations.subject: David Shea
relations.evidence: He moved on to the translation of the Dabistán. Before finishing however, he died... The translation of the Dabistán was completed by Anthony Troyer
